ShortDescription.Value: Maximize FPS and eliminate simulation/pathfinding lag in cities of up to 1,000,000 citizens with homeless loop breaker, HDRP shadow optimization, hover border removal, tree wind/growth pause, and smart traffic deadlock breaker.

Publish.LongDescription:
# ⚡ Ultra Performance & Simulation Booster (Beta v1.3.4) The definitive, all-in-one performance and simulation booster mod for Cities: Skylines II. Engineered from the ground up on the native DOTS / ECS architecture to eliminate CPU simulation delays, reduce pathfinding overhead, and maximize FPS in megalopolises with 700,000 to 1,000,000+ citizens.
---
### 🚀 Outside-the-Box Megacity Performance Upgrades (New in v1.3.4) - **⛺ Homeless Evacuation & Pathfinding Unblocker:** Solves the infamous Cities: Skylines II bug where thousands of homeless citizens get trapped camping in parks or road edges, flooding the pathfinding threads with endless recalculation loops. Features both automated periodic evacuation and a 1-click Quick Action button that instantly restores 1.0x-2.0x CPU simulation speed. - **🌑 HDRP Shadow Distance & Micro-Caster Optimizer:** Caps excessive 1500m+ shadow rendering down to a clean, crisp 450m via HDRP HDShadowSettings and filters micro-props from shadow passes. Frees up to 40% GPU rasterization overhead in dense skylines. - **🚫 Blue Hover Highlight Border Removal:** Eliminates the distracting cyan/blue outline border when hovering your mouse over buildings, citizens, vehicles, and props. Disables the HDRP OutlinesWorldUIPass, saving an entire geometry render pass and fullscreen composite shader blit every frame. - **🚶 Stuck Pedestrian Clearer:** Detects and despawns pedestrians caught with lane obstruction glitches on sidewalks, crosswalks, or subway stairs. - **🌊 100% Vanilla Water Stability:** Removed experimental water speed throttling to guarantee zero ship/boat bouncing, zero water trembling, and absolute hydrodynamic stability.
---
### 🌲 Foliage Performance: Tree Wind & Growth Control - **Tree Wind Sway Suspension:** Disables foliage wind vertex displacement in the volume stack, significantly reducing vertex shader overhead across thousands of trees. - **Tree Growth & Aging Freeze:** Pauses tree growth and decay simulation ticks, saving daily ECS CPU cycles while keeping forestry extractors fully operational. - **Zero Mod Conflicts:** 100% crash-free and fully compatible with Tree Controller, Line Tool, and Anarchy.
---
### 🏙️ Field Tested on a 700,000 Citizen Megacity Tested and validated on a massive 700,000 inhabitant city that suffered from extreme lag and constant freezing. By enabling key service automations, evacuating stuck homeless loops, and fine-tuning GPU shadow rendering, the city regained smooth simulation speed and significant FPS gains without rebuilding roads!
---
### ⚠️ Recommendations & Precautions: - **Save Backup:** While all operations use safe native ECS EntityManager commands, always create a manual backup of your city save before executing major city-wide purges. - **Service Gameplay Impact:** - **Auto Police:** Reduces crime to zero across the city. Police cruisers no longer clog streets. - **Auto Deathcare:** Instantly collects deceased citizens, preventing body accumulation in buildings without hearses. - **Auto Garbage:** Keeps buildings clean of waste without slow garbage trucks blocking avenues. - **Auto Road & Park Maintenance:** Keeps road condition at 100% and parks pristine without maintenance trucks. - **Auto Ambulance:** Immediately heals ill or injured citizens.
---
### 🔍 Known Behaviors & Tips: 1. **Temporarily Small / Cab-Only Trucks:** - After clearing stuck or orphan trailers, articulated trucks might appear as just the truck cab for a few seconds. This is normal ECS visual recreation; let the game run at 1x speed for a few moments and the trailers will re-attach properly. 2. **Ghost Bikes & Motorcycles:** - If you set "Invisible Citizens / NPCs" to active, the citizen pedaling or riding is hidden, but the two-wheeled vehicle remains visible. If this bothers you, simply enable the dedicated **"Invisible Bicycles"** and **"Invisible Motorcycles"** options in the mod panel.
---
### 🖥️ In-Game Floating HUD (GameTopLeft ⚡) Inspired by Better Transit View and Park Manager, the mod features a native top-left toolbar button (⚡) and an interactive floating panel with: - **16 Quick Action Cleanup Buttons:** Instant one-click triggers for Homeless Evacuation, Stuck Pedestrians Clear, Deadlock Clear, Trailers/Props Purge, Accidents, Garbage, Deathcare, Road Repairs, Park Maintenance, Health Cure, Mail Delivery, Animals Purge, Building Construction Completion, Foreign Taxis Despawn, and Parking Slots Cleanup. - **Live Settings & Toggles:** Switch between Basic, Medium, and Maximum presets, or customize individual entity visibility (NPCs, Vehicles, Bikes, Motorcycles, Hover Outline Border, Tree Wind, Floating Warning Icons, and HDRP Shadows). - **Status Notification Bar:** Real-time feedback for every action triggered.
---
### 🚦 Smart Deadlock Breaker Unlike older mods that despawned vehicles waiting at traffic lights or picking up passengers, our intelligent algorithm protects vehicles waiting at red lights, crosswalks, or loading bays, only intervening when a true circular deadlock or off-road glitch is detected.
---
### 🤖 Transparency & Active Developer Support (Disclaimer) This mod was created with the assistance of advanced AI, under my direct technical oversight, code review, and architectural supervision as a developer with coding knowledge.
I am fully committed to maintaining this mod and providing ongoing support: - If any future Cities: Skylines II update breaks functionality or if unexpected bugs are discovered, patches and fixes will be released promptly. - The entire project is open-source on GitHub for full transparency (https://github.com/demarscode2/cities2-ultra-performance-mod), allowing the community to inspect, verify, and understand the internal ECS systems and trust what is running in their game. - Feedback, bug reports, and suggestions are always welcome!
Publish.ChangeLog: - Beta 1.3.4 Release - Restored 100% Vanilla Water Stability: Completely deactivated experimental water speed throttling, eliminating ship/boat jumping and water surface trembling. - Added Hover Highlight Overlay Removal: Added option to disable the blue/cyan outline border on mouseover across buildings, sims, vehicles, and props, saving GPU passes. - Added Homeless Evacuation System: Fixes the game's notorious homeless loop bug where thousands of unhoused citizens endlessly recalculate pathfinding in parks, restoring CPU simulation speed. - Added HDRP Shadow Optimizer: Caps excessive shadow distance to a crisp 450m and filters micro-props from shadow maps, doubling GPU framerate in dense skylines. - Added Stuck Pedestrian Clearer: Despawns trapped pedestrians with lane obstruction glitches on crosswalks, sidewalks, and transit stations. - Updated GameVersion target to 1.6.*.
